title: Define delta packets for iterative context sessions

state.decision_rationale: Superseded by the broader causal-chain and differential-transport proposals, which were rejected for the core format. Iterative sessions should exchange standalone packets or use external Git/CAS transport.

provenance.source_label: Claude Fable feature idea: delta packets
provenance.review_target: Reported 39479-line MKTCTX/3 packet; exact artifact not identified

feedback.verbatim: Use @packet base=P... plus only changed, added, and removed files so iterative agent sessions do not pay full freight every turn and a chain records what the agent saw.
feedback.normalized_claim: Add a parent-bound delta profile that represents repository-context changes compactly and materializes a verifiable successor working set.

current_behavior: Every packet is a standalone selected snapshot with no base identity or inherited state.
Path-derived IDs, file hashes, omissions, and packet IDs provide primitives for computing differences but no delta grammar.
This proposal substantially overlaps Kimi's causal packet chain and Grok's delta-encoding proposals.

proposal.summary: Treat Claude's conversation-oriented delta use case as evidence for the causal-chain proposal and evaluate a minimal base-plus-change profile before designing general history semantics.
candidate_changes: Declare base packet identity and added, modified, removed, renamed, inherited, and omission changes.
Define materialization and verification against a required base packet.
Measure iterative-session bandwidth and token savings while retaining periodic standalone checkpoints.
Record whether an agent received a standalone snapshot, a delta, or a fully materialized chain.
non_goals: Do not duplicate the full causal-chain proposal as an unrelated feature.
Do not make deltas independently complete when their base is required.
Do not assume transport savings equal prompt-token savings unless the consumer can retain or retrieve base context.

questions: Can the target model or agent reliably retain a base packet between turns?
How often should a chain be compacted into a standalone checkpoint?
Does a delta carry changed final files, diffs, or both?
risks: Context-window consumers may need the base resent, eliminating token savings.
Long chains make reproducibility depend on every intermediate artifact.
Deletion and omission semantics can be confused.
evidence_needed: Conversation replay experiments with and without retained base context.
Materialization test vectors and chain compaction measurements.
Comparison of exact replacement bodies versus textual diffs.
